mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strong labor market conditions, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.0% signals expansionary economic conditions, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both INDPRO > 110 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing-related demand (HOUST) above 950 units signals heightened activity in the housing market, which correlates with broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during HOUST exceeding 950.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS exceeding 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE below 4.5%) coupled with rising payroll employment (PAYEMS above 137,800) indicates a robust labor market, fostering optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 137,800 in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during INDPRO exceeding 110.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening monetary cycle (e.g., rising FEDFUNDS), a sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS exceeding 2.5%, suggesting the economy is not in a tightening cycle.
